parameters.content:
## Order shipped → email customer
Runs every 5 min. Finds packing lists marked **Shipped** in the last 24h, finds the real customer email (intake application, then portal account), and emails them once.

**No duplicates:** every send is written to F&F `notification_logs`; an order already logged is skipped.

**Test mode is ON** in *Settings*: all emails go to `testRecipient`. Set `testMode` to false to go live.
